_comment: English synonym pairs, one base word per scene. 'word' is the common/basic English word; 'looks_like' holds a short 'instead of' label so the card shows the base word crossed out; 'actually' lists upgrade synonyms, shown with the check tag; 'vo' is the Bulgarian voice-over line teaching the swap. 'prompt' is the ComfyUI image prompt; deliberately objects/places, never people, since the model is weak at hands. DEMO DECK — a handful of example entries so a fresh clone runs. Replace this file with your own, or drop a private deck beside it as '<name>.local.json' (gitignored), which takes precedence.

items.vo: Вместо big опитай immense, vast или colossal — звучи далеч по-силно.
items.prompt: a towering ancient redwood trunk seen from its base looking up, misty forest, sense of scale

items.vo: Вместо good кажи excellent, superb или outstanding — по-точно и по-убедително.
items.prompt: a perfectly plated gourmet dish under warm restaurant lighting, fine dining presentation

items.vo: Вместо sad опитай melancholy, despondent или downcast — нюансите са различни.
items.prompt: rain streaking down a window pane overlooking a grey empty street, muted tones, quiet mood

items.vo: Вместо fast кажи rapid, swift или brisk — звучи по-образовано.
items.prompt: a mountain stream rushing over smooth stones, long exposure motion blur, crisp daylight
